method: captured live on 2026-08-07 with the connector's own httpx client and headers (tier-1, the configured selfcheck category); kept the three captured product nodes with every key _parse_product reads verbatim (same 2 KB rule for unread keys as the card fixture) and the meta keys the parser uses (title/length/category) — meta.filter alone carries ~640 KB of facets the parser never reads; the full raw response stays outside git in .agent/captures/detmir_category_raw.json
